rules: Warm desaturated palette only (sand, cream, taupe, espresso). NEVER cold grey, never loud colors. The location is REAL and lived-in: honest imperfections in the set, background rendered with true optical depth of field from a 50mm lens, never painted-looking blur. No mirrors. No smile (composed, serene). No text, no logos, no other people. SCENE-COLOR PAIRING: dark or dramatic dresses belong on the off-white studio backdrop; light cream dresses can live on warm or deep backdrops; never let every image drift into the same yellow-beige — the feed alternates COLOR WORLDS (white, chocolate, grey stone, sepia gold, pale Paris limestone, wine-dark night) with smooth transitions.
